title: Barrow-icebow.jpg
description: Icebow over the arctic ice in Barrow, Alaska.  An icebow is like that of a rainbow, except made from ice crystals in the air. Photo taken at at 9:40pm on May 24, 2005 by J.R. Manes.

title: Whalebone arch in Utqiagvik Alaska.png
description: Film photograph of a whalebone arch in Utqiagvik, Alaska. Utqiagvik was formerly heavily reliant on whaling for sustenance, and this whalebone arch is right on the waterfront where whalers would return from hunts.

title: Welcome to Barrow, Alaska.jpg
description: The traditional welcome sign at Barrow, Alaska. Notice the two whale jawbones. The body of the sign is written in Iñupiaq (Eskimo).

title: Barrow, Alaska commercial building.jpg
description: Three-story commercial building in "downtown" Barrow, Alaska .  Signage for Wells Fargo bank and ASTAC (the telephone utility cooperative for the North Slope) adorns its side.

title: Town of Barrow, Alaska.jpg
description: The town of Barrow, Alaska—the northernmost city in the United States— seen from the NASA P-3B during an IceBridge survey flight on Mar. 24, 2013. During this mission the IceBridge team flew over a field research site near Barrow, gathering data at the same time scientists on the ground were measuring snow depth and ice thickness.
